messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
Both cities observe daylight‑saving time, but they shift at the same rate, so the 9‑hour gap stays constant throughout the year.  

| Period | Los Angeles UTC offset | Berlin UTC offset | Difference |
|--------|-----------------------|-------------------|------------|
| Standard time | UTC‑8 | UTC+1 | +9 h |
| Daylight saving | UTC‑7 | UTC+2 | +9 h |

So when it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 p.m. in Berlin.
